name: grundriss
description: Trace a scanned floor plan, edit it in 2D, and see it in 3D, in the browser

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p server && vite build -c vite.site.config.ts && vite build --outDir dist/app --emptyOutDir false
scripts.server: npm run build:server && GRUNDRISS_APP=dist/app GRUNDRISS_DATA=server/data node server/dist/main.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src test site server/src server/test *.ts e2e *.json *.md index.html
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test site server/src server/test *.ts e2e *.json *.md index.html
